title: Channels
subtitle: Distribution channels, selling prices, and commission

ruleTypeHelp.markup_percent: Selling price = source rate plus this percentage.
ruleTypeHelp.markup_fixed: Selling price = source rate plus this amount, per night.
ruleTypeHelp.discount_percent: Selling price = source rate minus this percentage.
ruleTypeHelp.fixed_price: Selling price is always this amount per night in the window.
ruleTypeHelp.net_rate: Hotel receives this net amount per night; the channel sets its own selling price.

fields.name: Name

rulesDialog.ratePlanHelp: Scope the rule to one rate plan, or apply it to any plan.
